title: Character from split coordinates
statement: Given a binary subspace splitting of $H\subseteq bF_2^n$ and a vector $gamma\in bF_2^d$, define a sign-valued function on $ bF_2^n$ by sending $z$ to $(-1)^{langlegamma,yrangle}$, where $y$ is the second coordinate of the inverse image of $z$ under the splitting isomorphism and the inner product is over $ bF_2$.
hypotheses_covered: A binary subspace splitting of $H\subseteq bF_2^n$
